## About
IAS - International Auto Specialists is an independent repair shop on Illinois St in San Francisco. Yosof got his start in classic European restoration and now specializes in modern BMW and Mercedes vehicles.
One reviewer sums up the approach as dealer-level repairs, original parts and no shortcuts, in a shop that is organized and clean. Another customer lives in LA and still brings vehicles here.
Customers rate the shop 5 on Google across 22 reviews. Stop by on a weekday or send a note through the contact form to set up a visit.

## Services
- Modern BMW and Mercedes vehicles: The shop's specialty, done with dealer-level care and original parts.
- Diagnosis: Finding the real problem first, then a clear assessment before the work starts.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: Yosof specializes in modern BMW and Mercedes vehicles, and one reviewer recommends the shop to anyone with a German vehicle.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The shop is closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Send a message through the contact form on the website or give the shop a call, and you will hear back as soon as possible.

Q: Can you work with my insurance?
A: One longtime customer says Yosof has been reliable when she needed him to work with her insurance. Call to talk through your situation.

## What customers say
- "I've worked with a lot of mechanics over the years. Most are competent. Yusef is a cut above.
Yusef has been in the automotive industry since 2010, starting with classic European restoration before opening International Auto Specialists in 2015, where he specializes in modern BMW and Mercedes vehicles. The model is straightforward: dealer-level repairs, original parts, no shortcuts. The shop is organized and clean in a way that tells you something about how the work is done.
I recently brought my BMW X3 to IAS. The diagnosis was accurate, the work was thorough, and the car came back in better condition than I expected. No unnecessary upsells, no vague explanations — just a clear assessment and quality execution.
If you own a German vehicle and want it repaired properly, Yusef is who I'd call." (David Banie, 5/5)
- "A friend recommended Yosef to me, and I’m really glad I listened. From the start, I trusted him, and he’s consistently delivered. His work is fast, thorough, and he communicates clearly about what’s needed and why.

I actually live in LA, but I still go out of my way to bring my vehicles to him because once you find someone you trust, it’s worth it. Yosef inspected an RV for me before I bought it, which gave me peace of mind, and he’s worked on that same RV since. He also got a school bus fully checked and road-trip ready for me before Burning Man, making sure everything was safe before I hit the road. On top of that, he’s worked on two of my cars with the same level of care and attention.

It’s hard to find someone this reliable and honest. At this point, I wouldn’t go to anyone else." (Matthew Mourgides, 5/5)
